items.change: Widened @nestjs/common, @nestjs/core, and @nestjs/testing peer ranges to include ^12.0.0, and changed @nestjs/terminus to ^11.0.0 || ^12.0.0.
items.responds_to: NestJS 12 support and the Terminus 12 API compatibility change.

items.change: Replaced the HealthIndicator/HealthCheckError implementation with HealthIndicatorService.check(), returning session.up() for healthy checks and session.down() for unhealthy checks.
items.responds_to: @nestjs/terminus 12 removing HealthIndicator and HealthCheckError and providing HealthIndicatorService.

items.change: Registered HealthIndicatorService in the test module and changed unhealthy-case assertions from HealthCheckError exceptions to returned down results.
items.responds_to: The Terminus 12 health-indicator API no longer throws HealthCheckError.

items.change: Changed all Jest test scripts to invoke Jest through Node with --experimental-vm-modules.
items.responds_to: NestJS 12 being ESM-only and Jest requiring the VM-modules flag to load it.

items.change: Changed the test matrix to run NestJS 12 on Node 24 and NestJS 11 on Node 20, 22, and 24; added installation of NestJS 11 packages for the compatibility jobs; moved coverage and test-result uploads to the NestJS 12 Node 24 job; and changed the build job to Node 24.
items.responds_to: NestJS 12's ESM loading requirements and Jest's Node-version limitation.

items.change: Changed the stated supported NestJS versions from >=9.0.0 to NestJS 9–12.
Changed the documented NestJS requirement to versions 9, 10, 11, or 12.
Documented that unhealthy Terminus checks return a down result and that the indicator requires @nestjs/terminus 11 or 12.
items.responds_to: Terminus 12 removing HealthCheckError and changing the health-indicator API.

items.change: Updated the documented NestJS peer range to include ^12 and documented that NestJS 12 is ESM-only, requires Node 24.9+ for Jest tests, and uses --experimental-vm-modules.
items.responds_to: NestJS 12's ESM-only distribution and its Jest/Node runtime requirements.

items.change: Documented that NestJS 12 is ESM-only, specified the Node 20.19+ or 22.12+ runtime requirement for require(esm), linked the NestJS 12 testing guidance, and documented the Terminus 11-or-12 requirement.
items.responds_to: NestJS 12 being ESM-only and the resulting Node and Terminus compatibility requirements.

items.change: Added NestJS 12 ESM/runtime guidance and documented that the optional Terminus entry requires @nestjs/terminus 11 or 12.
items.responds_to: NestJS 12 being ESM-only and the updated Terminus compatibility range.

items.change: Added a NestJS 12 migration section covering the expanded peer ranges, Node require(esm) requirements, Jest's Node 24.9+ VM-modules requirement, the Terminus indicator API change, and the dropped Terminus 10 support.
items.responds_to: NestJS 12's ESM-only distribution and @nestjs/terminus 12 removing HealthIndicator and HealthCheckError.

items.change: Clarified that earlier versions threw HealthCheckError and that @nestjs/terminus 12 no longer provides it.
items.responds_to: The removal of HealthCheckError in Terminus 12.

items.change: Added instructions for testing with NestJS 12: run Jest through Node with --experimental-vm-modules on Node 24.9+, or test against NestJS 11 on Node 20/22.
items.responds_to: NestJS 12 being ESM-only and Jest's inability to load it on the older Node versions.

items.change: Added troubleshooting guidance for Jest's “Must use import to load ES Module” error, including the Node 24.9+ VM-modules invocation and the NestJS 11 fallback.
items.responds_to: NestJS 12's ESM-only modules failing to load through Jest's default require path.

items.change: Recorded that TemporalHealthIndicator now returns a down result instead of throwing HealthCheckError, and that peer support was widened to NestJS 12 and Terminus 11 or 12.
items.responds_to: The Terminus 12 removal of HealthIndicator and HealthCheckError and the addition of NestJS 12 support.
